propositions: Non-bug tickets (task/story/epic) cannot close via administrative dispositions (duplicate, obsolete, wontfix, superseded) today because close_precheck.py:64 gates the path to bugs only, forcing operators to use --force for 25+ legitimate administrative closes per week.

The completion-FAIL message does not enumerate the allowed close classes for a ticket's type, leaving operators unaware that a truthful administrative-disposition exit exists when --force is their apparent only option.

Obsolete and wontfix closes require a reason but the CLI parser refuses --reason without --force, preventing honest administrative closes and allowing reasons to be dropped or conflated with force_close_reason at the write boundary.

A reason-only administrative disposition (obsolete/wontfix) must skip AC/file-impact/billable verification and mint a SIGNED attestation with the class+reason line, but verdict() today returns None unless find_replacement resolves a live ticket.

The existing CLOSE_CLASSES enumeration excludes obsolete, superseded, and wontfix, so non-bug close types have no vocabulary for truthful administrative exits and drift-guards (DISPOSITION_CLASSES equality test, ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES subset test) must be added.

Replacement-bearing administrative classes (duplicate, superseded) must demand a live replacement link via widened _ensure_duplicate_close_is_linked, while reason-only classes (obsolete, wontfix) skip replacement-link checks and close on reason alone.
